card.name: Expelling air from syringes and sets
card.fires_on: The word just before "air" in priming and administration steps, mainly the "el" in "expel", and verbs like "introducing" or "remove" followed by air.

modes.label: Expel air
modes.description: The "el" of expel/expelling when clearing air or bubbles from a syringe or IV set.
modes.example: Open flow control clamp to exp<<el>> air from set and aortic infusion device

modes.label: Other air verbs
modes.description: Verbs such as introducing or remove that come right before air in line-priming or bag-preparation steps.
modes.example: Avoid foaming and<< introducing>> air in the infusion bag.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word "air" next.
card.plain: It fires on verbs about getting air out of, or keeping air out of, syringes and IV lines, right before the word air.
